Not a pure researcher.

Not a ticket-closer.

We want a hacker and builder. You will not be a small cog in a large machine. You will help define how this product evolves.

* Architect and own backend systems: APIs, data models, and services
* Integrate and orchestrate LLM workflows -- including reasoning models, decision models, and multi-step agentic pipelines -- into product flows

* Continuously improve the quality, reliability, and UX of AI-powered features in production

* Improve UX polish and system responsiveness
* Propose improvements to AI workflows

* Have built and shipped things outside of your job simply because you were curious, and can show us what you made
